nine_development_proposals.reason: The gate conditioned selection on prior human candidate labels.

policy_precision_definition: Linguistically correct surfaces (including serialization variants and valid extra diacritics) divided by all accepted candidate surfaces, counting review as noncorrect; no target-gold condition in policy selection.
source_safe_precision_definition: Exact safe source-preserving realizations divided by accepted candidates; narrower than grammatical correctness.
clustering: 19 candidates in 14 passages; no independent-candidate confidence interval.
pass1_temporal_integrity: All 19 judgments recorded in scratch work_normalized/morph_pass1.json before consulting previous normalized candidate correctness labels; queue target.previous_normalized_target_impact ignored.
pass2: Same-agent recheck of all 12 proposals, all 3 auto candidates, all 7 abstentions, and all wrong/partial/review policy surfaces; compared prior candidate labels only after pass1; no reclassification.
conclusion: Morphology is a useful surface ranker; neither analyzability nor contextual top-2 consensus verifies upstream correction correctness. The current 9/9 development proposals were selected with prior labels; gold-independent consensus accepts the wrong defective-noun candidate.
